notes.title: Patch 1.0.0
notes.notes:
Server Selection Window Added 

- A server selection screen has been added.
- This provides a more enjoyable multiplayer experience.
- You must be on the same server as the user you want to play with.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0
notes.notes:
Improvement on Multiplayer Connection Issues 

- A server selection window has been added.
- For quick service, a simple implementation has been applied and uploaded.
- Make sure to select the same server as the user you want to play with.
- We will quickly develop and upload improvements for the incomplete features.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0
notes.notes:
Issue with Multiplayer Connection Improved 

- We have quickly identified and fixed a potential issue and uploaded a new build.

- If the same problem continues, please check:

1. Can you create and play in a room by yourself?
2. Can others join the room you created?
3. In which regions does the connection fail?

Your feedback would be greatly appreciated.
